cases.title: README for a real CLI companion to the agent archive
cases.input:
Write a README.md for a new small open-source project. Keep it concise — it's a CLI, not a framework.

Project name: agentkit-cli
Purpose: a zero-config Node CLI that installs "install kits" from Agent Archive (https://yohan-work.github.io/agentive/) into your repo. Each project-ready agent in the archive publishes 7 files at stable URLs: https://yohan-work.github.io/agentive/kits/<slug>/{AGENTS.md,CLAUDE.md,cursor-rule.mdc,agent.json,README.md,RUNBOOK.md,EVALUATION.md}. Today users copy a curl one-liner per agent; this CLI does it for many agents at once and merges into existing files safely.

Tech stack: TypeScript, Node >= 20.9, commander for args, undici fetch, vitest for tests, tsup for bundling, published to npm as `agentkit-cli`. MIT license. Repo: github.com/yohan-work/agentkit-cli.

Features (all implemented in v0.3.0):
- `agentkit add <slug...>` downloads kits into ./agent-kits/<slug>/
- `agentkit add <slug> --target codex|claude|cursor` also appends the instructions to AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md, or writes .cursor/rules/<slug>.mdc
- Appends are wrapped in `<!-- agentkit:<slug>:start -->` / `<!-- agentkit:<slug>:end -->` markers, so re-running updates in place instead of duplicating
- `agentkit remove <slug>` removes the marked block and the kit folder
- `agentkit list` shows installed kits and their agent.json version
- `--dry-run` prints the diff without writing
- `--base-url` for self-hosted mirrors of the archive
- Exits non-zero if any file 404s; never overwrites files outside marked blocks

Setup / scripts:
```
npm install
npm run build      # tsup -> dist/
npm test           # vitest run
npm run lint       # eslint
npm run typecheck  # tsc --noEmit
npm link           # try the CLI locally
```
Usage example: `npx agentkit-cli add pr-review-agent test-case-generator --target claude`

Known limitations: no Windows CI yet (works on macOS/Linux in CI); no offline cache; no signature verification of downloaded files.

Roadmap: Windows CI, `agentkit update` to refresh all installed kits, checksum verification using agent.json, a `--pack <starter-pack>` option.

Audience: developers using Codex, Claude Code, or Cursor. Include getting started, scripts, and a roadmap section.
